The '''Red Neebray''' was a subgroup of the [[Balmorran resistance]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The Red Neebray attacked [[Sobrik]] and the [[Gorinth Canyon]], laying siege to the [[City/Legends|city]].
